expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Compares two typed class values by UClass identity. Compares the typed class value with a UClass by identity. Compares two object pointer wrappers by UObject identity. Compares the wrapper with a UObject reference by identity. Compares two weak pointers by object identity and serial state. Compares the resolved weak pointer with a UObject reference.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Representative left/right operands, identity or zero operands, and one boundary value; distinguish mutating compound operators from value-returning operators.
testScope: bool bEqual = Subclass == Other; | bool bEqual = Subclass == Class; | bool bEqual = ObjectPtr == Other; | bool bEqual = ObjectPtr == Object; | bool bEqual = WeakPtr == Other; | bool bEqual = WeakPtr == Object;
